verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own testing guide documents in-memory unit tests that mock all external calls, plus integration tests that deploy ephemeral infrastructure and test against it. `pulumi preview` shows proposed changes without applying anything, and plans allow unlimited stacks and environments for separate non-production targets. Together these give a documented way to test without touching production. Missing for 10: explicit docs on isolating sandbox stacks from production data, any agent-specific sandbox or guardrail flow for AI-driven testing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
